newsitem.title: USA: Two teens convicted of raping girl in classroom.
newsitem.headline: Two teens convicted of raping girl in classroom.

text.p: Two teenage boys have been convicted of raping a girl behind a movable blackboard in a South Philadelphia middle school classroom even though a substitute teacher was in the room at the time.

Family Court Judge Frank Reynolds Monday convicted the boys, who are 13 and 14, of raping a 13-year-old retarded girl at the Barratt Middle School on Feb. 13. They will be sentenced on May 29 and could be sent to a juvenile detention centre for up to four years each.

The 14-year-old denied any role in the incident but the victim said he held down her legs while the 13-year-old forced himself upon her. The two boys allegedly attacked her after being repulsed by another girl.
All four were in a special education class watched over by a 60-year-old substitute teacher, who witnesses testified was asleep during the incident. The teacher has been suspended.
